sandbox: fresh pointer check; drive known pointer coordinates through all nine targets; assert samples are stored

test: npm run test:claims -- --grep @claim:installer-checksum; Windows CI: pwsh -File tests/installer-checksum.ps1

claim: This comparison does not diagnose a condition or replace your device maker’s calibration
where: landing privacy section, result, exported report, README

where: landing install details, README install section
